name: questforge
description: Play persistent 5E-compatible fantasy campaigns with an AI Game Master, open dice, local state, and optional generated visuals.

interface.longDescription: Questforge turns a conversation into an open-ended fantasy campaign. It creates or imports a hero, runs original adventures with transparent 5E-compatible rulings and dice, preserves campaign and mechanical state, and can add generated scenes, tactical maps, 360 views, and optional ambience when the current surface supports them.
defaultPrompt: Start a new Questforge campaign with a quick hero.
Guide me through creating a hero, then begin.
